Messages.Author: Tim Eijpe
Messages.Body:
OK just to let me get this straight. I am too darn lazy to check the CL
thread.

Charming Lobby and a Political Action are 2 distict actions right? When
attempting a CL action, I do not play the PA (as of yes). Only if the CL is
not blocked I can play the PA. So If this CL is blocked, can I play Change
of
Target and call the PA I wanted to call with the CL? Assuming my first
assumption is correct I should, but if a CL-action is considered a PA, I
guess
I can't.

Just wondering as this would definately make the non-stealth vote decks a
lot
better. USe CL as bait, if blocket, CoT, and still call the PA after the CL.
Hmmn.

Tim
